name: Interval
description: The gap between two marks opening steadily across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @calc(28 - 26 * @x / @X)%; top: 30%; width: 40%; height: 40%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: @calc(28 - 26 * @x / @X)%; top: 30%; width: 40%; height: 40%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
